No. 337/4  Karukkanahalli Village, Denkanikottai Taluk, Krishnagiri District enhan  pay appropriate compensation to me by reconsidering the   22.11.2021 and 08.02.2022, by strictly following the procedure contempl  under Section 26 to 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparen  land Acquisition,Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Central Act  2013) and refix the compensation as per the provision of the Central Ac  2013 within a time frame to be fixed by this Court and also following t  procedures contemplated under Section 18 to 27 of the Arbitration and  Conciliation Act, 1996.

For Petitioner : Mr.J.Ramesh  For Respondents 1 to 3 : Mr.A.Selvendran  Special Government Pleader  For respondent 4 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan  ORDER The petitioner herein seek a direction to 1st respondent to pass arbitration award by considering his claim petition dated 18.06.2022 seeking enhancement of the compensation.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.

It is the case of the petitioner that the land of the petitioner situated in S.Nos. 33/5, 337/1 and 337/4A, measuring an extent of 1003 Sq.mtrs in S.No. 33/5 at Muthanahalli Village, Denkanikottai Taluk, Krishnagiri District, 1530 Sq. mtrs in S.No. 337/1 and 1710 Sq.Mtrs in S.No. 337/4A at Karukkanahalli Village, Denkanikottai Taluk, Krishnagiri District was acquired for extension of National Highways and not satisfied with the quantum of compensation fixed by the Land Acquisition Officer, the petitioner submitted the claim petition seeking enhancement of the compensation.

3. A.Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader, who takes notice for the respondents 1 to 3 submitted that the matter was already referred to arbitration by District Collector and he issued notice for enquiry on 03.10.2023.

4. In view of the said position that the matter is already referred to arbitration by 1st respondent and he also initiated arbitral proceedings, without going into the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, this Court is inclined to direct the 1st respondent to complete the arbitral proceedings and pass final award on merits within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.
